events.name: Mud Ruts
events.logText: Weather turns wet. The road becomes a ribbon of mud.
events.outcomeText: Progress slows as the cart fights through deep ruts.

events.name: Bandit Shakedown
events.logText: A road crew turns out to be armed men with polite smiles.
events.outcomeText: The Fox Hound Gang shakes down the crew. Some cargo goes missing.

events.name: Lucky Break
events.logText: A friendly farmer offers a shortcut through solid ground.
events.outcomeText: The crew makes excellent time and avoids the worst of the mud.

events.name: Broken Axle
events.logText: A loud crack echoes — the cart axle gives up.
events.outcomeText: Repairs cost time and a small fee. The cargo is mostly intact.

events.name: Heroic Help
events.logText: A passing patrol recognizes your paperwork and lends a hand.
events.outcomeText: Security improves for the rest of the trip; the crew arrives confidently.
